keyFindings.description: resolveCoreRoleHolder's switch sets `failure` inside the errors.As of the claim-read arm. The session-read and release arms work only because that arm runs first. Reordering the arms sends those failures to the 'churned past resolution bound' default with no compile error. Fix: call errors.As once before the switch and switch on failure.step.

sendOutcome is only half typed. The answer structs' Reason fields are still strings, filled through the identity reason(); settle switches on metric-label strings; line 455 logs a refused forward as `failed` while the recipient's outcome is delivery_failed. The type's doc says the log, the answer and the lane's lines read alike, but route lines log the raw outcome as delivery_status where the lane logs failed/skipped.

An ad-hoc send answered publish_failed, or a refused topic publish, adds nothing to envoy_messages_delivered_total. Every other failure through the route is counted (each unconfirmed recipient, every role send), so a hub outage seen through the route is invisible in that metric.
